active_inquiry.closure_condition: Close the inquiry after a fresh 120000-step PPO run using the existing policy, PPO, runtime, and environment recipe with only the target-radius exposure changed to 6-20 cm, followed by an independent task-predicate evaluation on a non-overlapping panel with the same failure decomposition. A positive conclusion requires a material reduction in inner-radius no-reach failures without an unacceptable loss of outer-radius success or complete-hold performance; a negative or limited conclusion is warranted if inner no-reach failures persist, if the candidate regresses materially on the 14-20 cm region or hold failures, or if the comparison is unavailable/inconclusive. Any persistent radius/angle or configuration-linked pattern will redirect the next decision toward branch, singularity/limit, contact, or dynamics characterization rather than establishing sampler exposure as the sole cause.
active_inquiry.goal_connection: The current best candidate achieves 110/160 (68.75%) on an independent task-predicate panel, leaving a 29.25 percentage-point development gap. Forty-two failures never entered tolerance, 46 of 50 failures occurred below 14 cm, and the baseline was never trained on that inner range. A full-radius candidate could therefore improve the probability of reaching the official 196/200 objective, while complete uninterrupted holding remains protected by separately scoring the eight entry-but-hold failures.
active_inquiry.handoff_conclusion: Observed facts: T1 was a fresh PPO run using the unchanged 64-64 tanh policy, current PPO parameters, one environment, and the 14-20 cm training sampler. Its proxy success reached 0.96 at 115712 and 120832 steps, but that proxy is not development evidence for the official distribution. M1 evaluated the 120832 checkpoint with the task success predicate on 160 independent seeds and preserved per-episode diagnostics. M1 records 110 successes, 42 failures with no first tolerance entry, and 8 failures that entered but had maximum holds below 100; 46 failures were at target radii below 14 cm. Interpretation: the initial direction should prioritize inner-workspace/generalization coverage, because the dominant observed failure is no reach on targets absent from training. This does not establish that sampler exposure is the sole cause: branch selection, singularity/limit conditioning, or configuration-dependent dynamics may explain why some inner targets fail. Hold stabilization remains a real secondary capability: its 8 failures and the model's 20 ms sampled boundary semantics mean it cannot be discarded. The current evidence does not identify the official probability measure beyond the contract, does not test a changed sampler, and does not characterize Jacobian conditioning, contacts, or physical dynamics. Reward and training-proxy rank are therefore insufficient for candidate selection toward the human goal.
active_inquiry.handoff_question: Does expanding the unchanged PPO baseline's training target-radius exposure from 14-20 cm to the official 6-20 cm range reduce inner-workspace no-reach failures enough to justify coverage-led development toward 98% while preserving complete-hold performance?

active_inquiry.rationale: Do not request the official assessment for a candidate supported at only 68.75% development success when the dominant observed failure class lies outside its training exposure and one full-radius candidate can directly test the highest-contribution development direction within the available allocation. This is a matched candidate comparison, not a causal proof that coverage alone explains the failures: branch selection, singularity/limit conditioning, and configuration-dependent dynamics remain consequential alternatives. The proposed run is bounded to one full allocation plus the same independent evaluation; its radius- and angle-stratified reach-versus-hold result will either justify continued coverage-led work or redirect the inquiry toward those alternatives. The proposed question is deliberately corrected from the inherited meta-question about whether to open an inquiry: M1 already supports opening one, while the unresolved scientific question is the effect of the changed candidate.

request.decision_frontier: The unresolved direction is whether the best next investment is (A) broadened target exposure to the official 6-20 cm range with the existing controller recipe, or (B) explicit branch/singularity/dynamics characterization and a control or observation redesign before further learning. The discriminating evidence is a matched candidate trained with full-radius exposure and evaluated with the same independent task predicate, with radius/angle-stratified success and reach-versus-hold diagnostics. A strong reduction in inner no-reach failures while preserving outer success would justify continuing exposure expansion; persistent failures concentrated by angle or configuration would redirect toward branch, limit, Jacobian, or dynamics investigation. The first learned baseline is far from that objective on an independent development panel, so the campaign must improve complete-task success rather than optimize reward or first reach.
